# BufferWriter

A fixed buffer being filled with text from the front.

```rux
pub struct BufferWriter {
    // private fields
}
```

Holds well-formed UTF-8 at every moment. A write either appends its whole run or changes nothing, so what has
been written is always the concatenation of the runs that succeeded.
Copying is not prohibited, but a copy is a second cursor over the same storage rather than a second buffer, so
writes through one are invisible to the other and the two will overwrite each other. Borrow it as
`&var TextWriter` and let it be the one writer over its room.
The room it was built over must outlive it. It stores the slice, and nothing here tracks that.

## Constructors

<h3 id="new"><code>BufferWriter</code></h3>

```rux
pub func BufferWriter(room: var char8[..]) -> BufferWriter
```

A writer over `room`, filling from its start.
Nothing in `room` is read or cleared: what has not been written is not part of the text, and [`Written`](/docs/api/text/buffer-writer#written) never
reaches it.
Cannot fail. Runs in constant time and allocates nothing.

| Name   | Type            | Description                                        |
| ------ | --------------- | -------------------------------------------------- |
| `room` | `var char8[..]` | the storage to fill, which must outlive the writer |

**Returns**: a writer holding no text yet

[Source](https://github.com/rux-lang/Rux/blob/main/Packages/Text/Src/BufferWriter.rux#L37)

## Methods

<h3 id="written"><code>Written</code></h3>

```rux
pub func Written(self: &BufferWriter) -> char8[..]
```

The text written so far.
Well-formed UTF-8, and exactly the runs that succeeded: a refused write left nothing behind to appear here.
The result borrows the writer's room and must not outlive it.
Borrows the writer. Cannot fail; runs in constant time and allocates nothing.

**Returns**: the bytes written, which are valid UTF-8

[Source](https://github.com/rux-lang/Rux/blob/main/Packages/Text/Src/BufferWriter.rux#L47)

<h3 id="length"><code>Length</code></h3>

```rux
pub func Length(self: &BufferWriter) -> uint
```

How many bytes of text the writer holds.
Borrows the writer. Cannot fail; runs in constant time and allocates nothing.

**Returns**: the byte count, which is not a character count

[Source](https://github.com/rux-lang/Rux/blob/main/Packages/Text/Src/BufferWriter.rux#L55)

<h3 id="remaining"><code>Remaining</code></h3>

```rux
pub func Remaining(self: &BufferWriter) -> uint
```

How many more bytes will fit.
A caller sizing a write can ask, but need not: a write that does not fit is refused whole rather than
truncated, so asking first is an optimization and never a correctness requirement.
Borrows the writer. Cannot fail; runs in constant time and allocates nothing.

**Returns**: the remaining capacity in bytes

[Source](https://github.com/rux-lang/Rux/blob/main/Packages/Text/Src/BufferWriter.rux#L65)

<h3 id="clear"><code>Clear</code></h3>

```rux
pub func Clear(self: &var BufferWriter)
```

Discards the text written so far, keeping the room.
The bytes are not overwritten, because they are no longer text as far as this writer is concerned and
nothing can reach them: [`Written`](/docs/api/text/buffer-writer#written) stops at the length. A caller clearing secrets wants `ZeroizeBlock` from
`Rux/Memory` on the room itself.
Borrows the writer exclusively. Cannot fail; runs in constant time and allocates nothing.

[Source](https://github.com/rux-lang/Rux/blob/main/Packages/Text/Src/BufferWriter.rux#L75)

## Implements TextWriter

`BufferWriter` conforms to [`TextWriter`](/docs/api/text/text-writer).

<h3 id="write"><code>Write</code></h3>

```rux
pub func Write(
    self: &var BufferWriter,
    bytes: char8[..]
) -> ! FormatError
```

Appends `bytes`, whole or not at all.
Reports `InsufficientCapacity` when the run does not fit, and `TextFailure(InvalidUtf8)` when it is not
well-formed UTF-8. In both cases the buffer is exactly as it was, so a caller may write the same run to a
larger destination without first undoing a partial one. Capacity is decided before validity, since a run
that cannot land is not worth reading.
These are the only two failures this writer produces. There is no destination beyond the buffer, so a
`WriterFailure` cannot arise, and the other `TextFailure` reasons belong to allocation and to boundary
arithmetic, neither of which a fixed buffer performs.

| Name    | Type        | Description                    |
| ------- | ----------- | ------------------------------ |
| `bytes` | `char8[..]` | the UTF-8 run to append, whole |

**Returns**: success when the complete run was appended

[Source](https://github.com/rux-lang/Rux/blob/main/Packages/Text/Src/BufferWriter.rux#L92)
